name: OC Transpo static GTFS
reason: A zip URL used by transit catalogs responded, but the publisher terms page https://www.octranspo.com/en/plan-your-trip/travel-tools/developers/dev-terms returned HTTP 403. The licence text could not be confirmed, so the feed was not imported.

name: York Region Transit GTFS
reason: YRT publishes an Open Data Licence Agreement, and the download is behind a named-person request form. No anonymous file URL was available, so the feed was not retrieved.

name: City of Ottawa public washrooms
reason: The Open Ottawa dataset page loaded, and the embedded item licenseInfo was null. The linked open-data licence page did not return licence text during this run, so the dataset was not imported.

name: GO Transit and UP Express stop_amenities.txt
reason: The downloaded GO and UP Express zips contain stop_amenities.txt with a washroom column coded as integers. No data dictionary was in the feed, so the codes were not interpreted and the file was not imported.
